snippet.title: Little Nightmares III – The Backstage DLC Reveal (Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass)
snippet.description:
Some secrets may be better left behind the curtain. Why is it so tempting to peek, though?

#LittleNightmares III’s first DLC – The Backstage – arrives June 12 as part of the Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass.

Wishlist now.
